desc: Establish the contiguous interval-expansion viewpoint and positivity observation.
Derive and prove the maximum-Cartesian-tree characterization, including equal-value cases.
Validate the characterization on both public samples and representative equal/barrier cases.
Establish \(O(N\log N)\) time and compact-memory binary lifting with 64-bit subtree sums.
Implement the finalized Python solution with fast stdin/stdout handling.
